Metadata.title: Arewa Is Building
Metadata.description: Discover software built in Northern Nigeria and by Arewa people everywhere.

Home.intro: A considered directory for useful digital products, ambitious builders and practical ideas from Northern Nigeria and the diaspora.
Home.searchPlaceholder: Try a product, category, state or alternative…
Home.latestIntro: Useful products with roots in the North. Every public listing has passed editorial review.
Home.browseByIntro: Start with a place or a product category.
Home.whyIntro: The North is full of people solving real problems. This is a place to make that work easier to find.
Home.whyOneText: Put products from Kano to Makurdi in front of the people who need them.
Home.whyTwoText: Find practical alternatives shaped by local context, language and everyday needs.
Home.whyThreeText: We curate submissions so the directory stays useful, credible and easy to browse.
Home.whyFourText: Arewa builders everywhere have a home here.
Home.ctaText: Tell us about it. We review every listing before it becomes part of the directory.

Directory.title: The directory
Directory.intro: Software, services and experiments built by people connected to Arewa.
Directory.searchPlaceholder: Search products, states, categories or alternatives
Directory.filtersDescription: Narrow the directory to what matters to you.
Directory.noResultsText: Try clearing a filter or searching for something broader.

Product.seedNote: This is a seed listing included while the directory grows. Details are reviewed before publication.

Submit.title: Put your work on the map.
Submit.intro: Tell us about a product built in Arewa or by an Arewa builder. It will be reviewed before it is published.
Submit.signInText: A free account lets you submit a product and follow its review status.
Submit.name: Product name
Submit.alternativesHint: Separate names with commas, for example: Trello, Notion
Submit.tagsHint: Separate up to five tags with commas
Submit.uploadHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, max 5 MB each.
Submit.successText: Thanks for submitting {name}. We’ll email you when there is an update.

Auth.title: Welcome to Arewa Is Building
Auth.intro: Sign in to submit a product and manage its review status.
Auth.sentText: We sent a sign-in link to {email}.
Auth.configError: Authentication is not configured yet. Add the Supabase variables in .env.local to enable sign-in.
Auth.privacyNote: Your account helps keep submissions connected to the people who made them. We only use it for directory participation and review updates.

Account.title: My submissions
Account.intro: Follow each listing from submission to review.
Account.empty: You have not submitted a product yet.
Account.emptyText: Know a useful tool made in Arewa? Submit it for review.
Account.websiteNote: Website URLs stay fixed while a listing is under review.
Account.updated: Your pending submission has been updated.
Account.editIntro: Update the important details while the listing is still in review.

Admin.title: Review queue
Admin.intro: Review submissions with the same care people put into making them.
Admin.reasonPlaceholder: Give the maker a useful, specific reason.
Admin.notAllowed: You do not have permission to review submissions.

NotFound.text: The product or page may not be public yet. The directory is a good place to continue.
